body:
Lina: quick scan across regions — seeing compressed headroom in a couple spots for the next 30 days, sharing a compact snapshot and a proposed short-term mitigation plan.

Lina: ```
Region   | Committed GPUs | Projected avg demand | Projected 95th-day
us-west2  | 520            | 610                  | 695
eu-west1  | 340            | 395                  | 430
ap-northeast1 | 140       | 125                  | 150
```

Lina: baseline assumptions: recent 14-day median growth, no quota smoothing, +planned product promo in week 2 (conservative uplift).

Raj: noted. if promo misses by 40% what does us-west2 look like?

Lina: under -40% promo scenario -> us-west2 avg ~570, 95th ~645. still above committed but the gap narrows.

Mei: low-risk optimization: enable aggressive prefix caching and slightly longer KV cache TTLs for top 10 customers -> expect ~12% sustained token reduction for affected tails. no infra deploy, just config change.

Tom: finance heads-up: covering gap in us-west2 with ondemand GPUs for 30 days would run ~ $78k estimated. linking to internal breakdown. @finance-team FYI.

billing-bot: ondemand-coverage estimate: $78,200 for 30-day peak window. details: https://billing.redwood.internal/overages/1955550000

Raj: alternative short-term routing: shift non-SLA traffic to us-east1 and ap-northeast1 where we have spare capacity. tradeoff: +10-15ms median latency for some EU traffic.

Mei: we can implement a weighted routing policy (route tag: "low-prio") and divert ~25% of eligible requests. I'll run a sim for p50/p95 latency & cost impact.

Lina: plan for next 72h: (1) Mei -> staging + canary for routing weights (target canary start 08:30 UTC tomorrow), (2) Tom -> run reserve-vs-ondemand calc for commit sizes [32,64,96], (3) Raj -> produce break-even days + risk matrix and include caching uplift. I'll coordinate with finance signoff.

Tom: quick numbers (rough):
Option 1: +32 commit in us-west2 -> +$23,500/mo, reduces ondemand delta to ~$54k for 30-day peak
Option 2: +64 commit -> +$44,800/mo, reduces ondemand delta to ~$32k
Option 3: cover with ondemand -> ~$78k for 30 days
Tom: I'll produce a proper amortized break-even sheet in ~4h.

infra-bot: snapshot: us-west2 GPU utilization 79% (1h avg), queue depth +22% last 24h.

Mei: staging routing test: pass. no error uptick, p50 latency +6ms. scheduling canary at 08:30 UTC -> criteria: abort if p50 > baseline + 12ms or errors > 0.6%.

Raj: drafting scenarios doc now. will attach sensitivity curves and recommended commit band by EOD.

finance-team: please include contract flexibility notes (ability to downscale after 30/60 days) and any marketplace cancellation windows. we need cancellation lead times.

Lina: good call. add contract windows to Raj's doc and Tom's calc. owners: Tom(cost calc), Mei(routing/caching canary), Raj(scenarios + contract addendum), Lina(coord + finance handoff).

Lina: we'll reconvene after canary metrics and Tom's final calc. leaving thread open for async updates. :white_check_mark:
